verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents creating payment links through its API docs and its hosted MCP server, which lets an agent create and manage payment links directly. The evidence shows no product or price catalog objects that an agent could provision first, so only the payment-link part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: API-provisionable product objects, API-provisionable price objects, any documented single-session flow chaining product→price→link, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session

citations.quote: Query payment statuses, issue refunds, void payments, and create and manage payment links
